answer: If the beacon lapses or a duplicate identity is proven, the bond is slashed to a residual ember of its former worth, so running N fake agents costs N times the stake. Sybil resistance here uses a ferrous stake bond: every new agent must lock real value in a bonded vault prior to voting, and each epoch it broadcasts a signed beacon proving liveness. Attackers must burn capital proportional to their fleet size while honest agents recover their bond, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
